# Tropical Line Designs
> Premier landscape architecture firm specializing in tropical resort, hotel, and villa design in Bali, Indonesia since 1990

## About
Tropical Line Designs is a leading landscape architecture and construction company based in Bali, Indonesia. Founded in 1990 by Tamyani Adi Kusumo (YeYeQ), a graduate of Universitas Udayana's Art and Design program, the firm has over 34 years of experience creating exceptional tropical landscapes.

## Services
- Landscape Design: Tropical resort design, hotel landscape architecture, villa gardens, commercial landscapes
- Landscape Construction: Full turnkey construction services from concept to completion
- Project Types: Hotels, resorts, theme parks, villas, offices, apartments, residential houses

## Design Philosophy
1. Refined Simplicity: Clean, elegant lines that highlight natural beauty
2. The Right Plant on The Right Place: Ecological approach ensuring sustainable, low-maintenance landscapes
3. Respecting Tradition: Integrating local culture and environmental context into modern design

## Notable Projects
- Ibu Kota Nusantara (IKN) - Indonesia's new capital city
- Sofitel Bali Nusa Dua Beach Resort
- The Oberoi Lombok
- Marriott Hotels (multiple locations)
- Anantara Bali
- Sheraton Yogyakarta
- St. Regis Jakarta
- Radisson Blu Bali Uluwatu
- Four Seasons Hotel Jakarta

## Location
Based in Bali, Indonesia - serving projects throughout Indonesia and internationally

## Expertise
- Tropical climate landscape design
- Resort and hospitality landscape architecture
- Sustainable and ecological landscape solutions
- Commercial and residential landscape design
- Full design-build services
